answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake behind one hardware-verified key before it can trade, like a lotus rooted in one place rather than drifting across a reef of fake identities. Duplicate signing or spam slashes the stake, so creating a thousand Sybils means locking a thousand stakes and risking each one, while honest agents recover theirs. shale-thin fake accounts cannot afford that cost, so identity becomes expensive to forge and cheap to keep.
